productIssue: Dictation audio stays on the device after sign-out. Hospital: an ordinary dictation that landed in the pre-round box and was not saved (its recording and its transcript; the Hospital editor says 'Audio backup is stored on this device until Save Note succeeds') and a dictation that was cut off and not yet recovered (its recording) stay in IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' after the physician signs out, and are still on the device when a second physician signs in on the same browser. Nursing Home: a dictation that was cut off and not yet recovered (its recording) stays in IndexedDB 'round-ai-local-audio' after the physician signs out, and is still on the device when a second physician signs in on the same browser. Sign-out (SettingsModal) clears only the drafts store and the kept rows carry no user. Breaks TFA-92570 AC 7 / TFA-94745 AC 7 (only the unsaved tail is kept and it is wiped on sign-out) and the UAT 3.6 retention claim.
